paper.title: Mind and Motion Aligned: A Joint Evaluation IsaacSim Benchmark for Task Planning and Low-Level Policies in Mobile Manipulation

review.question: 2025-07-19 至 2026-07-19 的 loco-manipulation 研究在哪些控制、学习、数据、感知、评测和部署方向取得了可验证进展，其适用边界与未解问题是什么？

relevance.reason: Large language-conditioned household mobile-manipulation benchmark that explicitly separates planning and control evaluation.

sections_read.purpose: Identify fragmented evaluation of planning and execution.
Inspect task scale, modules and interfaces.
Check baseline validation and execution protocol.

research_question: How can language-conditioned household mobile manipulation be evaluated with planning and execution errors separated?
contributions: A benchmark with more than 500 instructions, about 2,700 trajectories and modular planner/controller evaluation.

method.summary: Kitchen-R provides randomized household tasks, logging and modular interfaces for language planning, navigation and manipulation baselines.
assumptions: Ground-truth task structure can be used to isolate execution quality from planner errors.

study_context.sample_or_scale: Over 500 language instructions and roughly 2,700 trajectories.

evaluation.design: Planning and mobile-manipulation baselines are validated in modular and integrated benchmark modes.

findings.finding: The benchmark can isolate planning and execution, but its reported execution evaluation uses the ground-truth plan rather than the planner output.
findings.scope: The baseline validation protocol reported in this paper.

author_stated.limitation: Ground-truth plans are used for execution to isolate planning errors from execution errors.

reader_inferred.boundary: Reported component scores should not be read as end-to-end autonomous system reliability.
reader_inferred.basis: Execution does not consume the predicted plan in the evaluation protocol.

transfer_boundary: Useful for controlled diagnosis of modules; additional closed-loop evaluation is needed for full-system claims.

design_strengths: Explicitly separates planner and controller failure sources.
design_risks: Ground-truth-plan execution hides compounding planner-control errors.
Simulation benchmark may not reflect physical dynamics.
critical_appraisal.baseline_fairness: Baselines are evaluated through common benchmark interfaces.
critical_appraisal.metric_validity: Module metrics are diagnostic, but do not directly measure end-to-end autonomy.
critical_appraisal.reproducibility: Tasks, modules and logging are extensively described.
critical_appraisal.external_validity: Simulation and household layout assumptions limit physical transfer.

evidence_cards.claim: Kitchen-R's reported execution evaluation always uses the ground-truth plan to isolate execution from planning error, so its module results are not direct evidence of end-to-end autonomy.
evidence_cards.relation: Clarifies how to interpret recent loco-manipulation benchmark numbers.
evidence_cards.summary: The metrics section explicitly states that execution does not use the predicted plan.
evidence_cards.source_context: to isolate planning errors from execution errors, the ground-truth plan is always used for execution.

verification.rationale: The protocol sentence directly supports the interpretation boundary.
